title: Quenched Jamaican Mayonnaise Salsa Comal
description: A resinous, light, indulgent Jamaican dish featuring mayonnaise and pickle. Perfect for a Whole30-friendly dinner option.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, scotch bonnet pepper, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add the mayonnaise and whisk until smooth. Add the pickle relish and whisk until combined. Stir in the ground cinnamon.
Heat the coconut oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the red onion and cook until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Add the fresh cilantro and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the mayonnaise mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until heated through.
Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve warm over your favorite Jamaican dish or as a dip for your favorite vegetables.
